notes.title: Comedy Night - Disco Ball + UI refresh
notes.content:
New Features
We have reworked a lot of the user interface (UI) to improve the overall experience of Comedy Night.
This update adds support for cross-play in the coming weeks (iOS & Android).


 New Main Menu where you can see your current Avatar
 New Disco room feature adds a disco ball to the room.
 Improved memory management reduces game load time by only loading the avatars content when needed.
 Higher quality textures for the Avatars
 Sending chat messages now supports clickable URL's as well, so for example if you talking about a YouTube video you can send that via chat and everyone can click it to open the video. Only certain URL's are supported to prevent bad links ie. YouTube, X, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, SoundCloud and a few others.
 Chat messages now display for 15 seconds instead of 5 seconds.
 For Face Masks you are no longer forced to upload an image that's exactly 500x500, it will auto resize the image to 500 x 500 for you.
 You can now leave a room without having to press ESC key on your keyboard.
 Your player badge in the bottom right corner now includes an icon to show it's clickable


Lobby
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/32b28275603f6eb06fc4231e43c2abdf2d7a80e5.jpg

 You no longer have to choose a Region every time you enter the game, instead now it will remember what you last used. You can change it directly from the lobby.
 Added a "total players online" so you can see if there are players waiting in the lobby to join a room.
 You can now see which of your Steam friends are in a room without having to go into the room.
 The lobby will now auto-refresh without you having to click "refresh lobby" each time a change happens.
 For new players it will generate a room in the lobby with a random room name for you so you can easily start your own room.


Token Balance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/56672792cefba37be6b032421ba629af489c79bd.jpg

 Added a new token balance widget to the top left of the room to always see your balance.
 It also shows you a countdown of how long to go until your next free token.
 Free tokens are now dropped every 45 min (instead of 60) with a maximum of 3 per day. (you need to be in a room for it to countdown)
 Tap to open Token store.


Room Info
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/69b7cdabd86a1cc51f9684ff25b3f8f946e640db.jpg

 The room info panel has been simplified
 4 quick buttons to set the room to Open/Private, Stage Timer, Crowd Chat on/off, and Announcer 
on/off.
 We also now automatically hide the Stage Line-Up when there are no players waiting to go up on stage.
 Add a menu icon when you are the Room Admin to make it easier for new players to know they can edit the settings by clicking the Room Info panel.
 The Room description now also support clickable links for certain websites (like YouTube, X, Twitch, Kick, TikTok, SoundCloud and a few others)


Player Profiles
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/1f56fe22d1ecfffc5a5055c993a982e96f483f5c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/0fb75f2ba0bdcece560ba59c83e93e955700ccd3.jpg

 We've added new Player Profiles which you can view by left clicking on a player.
 You can follow players, this is to support friends across devices, so if you follow an iPhone player and they follow you back then you will be able to send them invites to rooms. Note! If you follow a Steam player and they follow you back but you are not friends on Steam then you will not be able to send them Steam invites to the room. (You have to be Steam friends as well in order to send Steam game invites. This is a Steam restriction)
 There is also an option to rate a player (bad, good, excellent)


Room Players
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/3fda6b74843d42a2de398e999fc1649c4f8793b0.jpg
Pressing Tab or the Players icon next to the Microphone will now open a new Room Players panel as seen in this image. It gives you an overview of who is the room and the positions match where they are seated in the room making it easier to manage a room as an Admin. Left clicking a player will open their Player Profile and tapping the "+" buttons will open a new in-game room invite screen.

Leaderboards
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/69bd1585a1e88d4462fd5623bca5d60d9c3b0969.jpg

 Redesigned Leaderboard screen
 Player steam profile images are now visible
 New Monthly Leaderboards (Overall Leaderboard still exists as well)

notes.title: The Big Beer March Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/4caeb53cc66774fb3995ccf4ff6d77868ab3b544.png
Barman Willy McGregor, the bare-knuckled boxing champion of Dublin

The Bar is now Open
This month's update is a big one with some major features being added including the much-requested addition of a barman. Let me introduce our one-eyed Irish barman, Willy McGregor.

Drinks, Food and Game Tokens
Unlock Free Game tokens every day to spend at the bar (receive a free game token every day, and one extra per hour of gameplay (max 3 a day)). Buy drinks and food for yourself or for other players. Eating or drinking items unlocks new animations and sound effects. A well-timed fart in a crowded room always brings a smile.  Buy your favorite performer a drink or a can of beans to show your appreciation, tipping the barman with a Game Token is also an option.

Let us know in the comments what other items you would like to see added to the menu.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/31a8ebf911aa9cb38dc91f8755b93eb877c77203.png
Order from the menu using game tokens

New Animations and Sound Effects
Eating or drinking an item unlocks new animations and sound effects. Toast a player's performance, have down-downs, or nurse your drink and sip it slowly and enjoy it. Between eating and drinking, check the animation panel to see what new sfx and actions you can use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/b4beeb880ef5f792c631aded645c7c53ab87e7d0.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/944330559a495f457bb5e0c8a0f226859937aa1f.png

Leaderboards and Earning Points
Eating, drinking, gifting, and tipping all earn you points to climb the Leaderboards. You can now know for certain if you Comedy Night's Biggest Drinker, Most Gifted, Top tipper or a Top players.
Take a look a the leaderboards and see how you stack up.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/94d6767fdf40d203969163edb037aaffc6eb12f0.png

Updates and Improvments
We have added some quick access admin buttons, to help players manage the rooms better as well as performance improvements, the Scottish and Welsh flags.Below is a list of all the features added in this update.

 Added a Barman - Willy McGregor
 Bar Items are now for sale with Game Tokens
 (receive a free game token every day, and one extra per hour of gameplay (max 3 a day))
 Beers now available from the Bar (on consuming unlock special action - Burb)
 Beans now available from the Bar (on consuming unlock special action - Fart)
 Leaderboards - Biggest Drinkers, Most Gifted, Top Tippers, and Top Players
 Earn points for eating, drinking, tipping, receiving gifts, and giving gifts.
 (available from both the Main Menu and the Player Badge)
 Tip Barman (show your generosity on the new Top Tipper Leaderboard)
 Beans and Beers can be gifted too other players
 Admin now has Quick access buttons below the performers Player Badge to Kick off Stage or Ban from Room (only visible when you move over the badge area)
 OTHER CHANGES
 Added Scottish Flag
 Added Welsh Flag
 Splash screen now maintains aspect ratio correctly
 Performance improvements to some avatar and avatar items
 Prevent issue where it would show the "connecting" menu forever when you had lost connection to Steam (now displays a message box that you failed to connect)
 Few minor tweaks and improvements

Thanks for all your support and suggestions. See you all down at the bar tonight.

notes.title: Comedy Night - February Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/5b1d0d684e6f139569b1a41975e74fbb13d942f6.jpgGame Update
We have another great update this month for Comedy Night, things may look and feel a bit different as we have overhauled the visual effects in the room so not only do things look better but it runs faster too. 

We have added a new "Offensive" Room tag (so players know what they can expect when joining some of the more edgy rooms) Hopefully this helps players find the sessions they want to be in. We have added more admin controls and the room settings have been simplified, we now only show the important stuff. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/0e2de559244fad81c5bbde212d4d787daf674787.jpg
Simplified room settings and new offensive room tag

A great new feature that makes it easier to identify players has been added, right-click on a player in the room and they highlight, hovering over a player's name in the Quick Menu will also highlight the player, and hovering over the Admin panel in the top right corner will highlight the room admin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/7db9899671b1fb0337ba3194daf443502f34922b.jpg
Right clicking on players highlights them

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/76911494b6c14ff58f647e4b64ecbd9317c23309.jpg
New graphic settings panel with more options and a FPS counter

These are only a few of the main features of the update. See the changelog below 
Keep the feedback coming and let us know what you want to see in next month's update.

Game Changelog

 Graphical visual effects overhaul (looks better and runs faster)
 Shiny Female Blue dress enhanced effect
 Shiny Red Blazor enhanced effect
 Improved visor glasses effect
 New options menu settings - MSAA now supported
 New options menu settings - New shadow quality improvements
 Glass effect for side panels (both left and right)
 New "Offensive" Room tag (lets players know what they can expect in that room)
 Simplified the room settings on the right of the screen only showing the important stuff
 Room settings on the right now shows what Room Type you are in (Music, Comedy etc.)
 F9 now turns on/off a FPS counter
 Options menu now automatically shows a FPS counter
 You can now click on the players in the Queue list to view their steam profile
 Hovering over the players in the queue will now highlight where they are in the room
 Hovering over the Admin panel in the top right corner will now highlight the Admin in the room
 Hovering over a players name in the Quick Menu on the left will now highlight the player in the room
 Right-clicking on a player will now highlight the player so you know exactly who you have selected
 New Right-Click player menu
 As a Room Admin it now instantly shows the players name when you hover over a player as well as highlights them so that you can easily identify a player if you need to kick/mute/ban them
 When you hover over a player it now also shows their Flag next to their name
 When someone is talking in the crowd for a few seconds all the players will now look at that player (except if the person on stage is talking then they will remain looking at them)
 Added the Trans Pride flag
 Added the Australian Aboriginal flag
 Added more font special characters (so fewer square symbols should show)
 Removed the Yellow from the Lobby warning system
 Bug Fix - Timer on Player Badge showed even when it was disabled
 Bug Fix - Timer did not show for the player on stage if changed whilst on stage
 AFK will now kick the player from the room (prevents the bug with 2 AFK players constantly swapping admin) and also frees up a seat.

notes.title: Comedy Night -January Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/25607097aec79de5076ff6a31b7af9d97c67370a.jpg
We rolled out a number of changes this month to improve the Comedy Night experience. Many of these features are based on community feedback, thank you for all the suggestions. We have a great roadmap of new features coming up over the next few weeks/months that really is going to be game-changing. 

Added a Leave Room button to the Quick menu (so you can leave without using a keyboard)
Added more racist filters to Room Names, Descriptions, and text chats.
If the Room Admin is AFK for 15 minutes it will auto switch to a new Room Admin (it will prompt you first and you have 15 seconds to respond before it switches).
If there is nobody in the room then it auto shuts down the room.
If a Room Admin Mutes a player it Mutes that player for everyone in the room.
If a Muted player tries to talk it now shows their chat bubble in Red with a Mute icon
If a Muted player goes up on stage and then sits back down it now remembers that they were muted (previously they would become unmuted)
Room admin can now enable/disable crowd voice chat from the quick menu when someone is on stage.
Added new Free Player Banners  
Added new premium glasses 
Glasses & Instrument bundles now show in the Player Badge lists.
Fixed a bug where if you are in a room and on stage and then join another room via invite or via Steam friends list you would show up in the new room on stage (even if someone was already on stage)

Thanks for the support, see you all at the Comedy Night Bar tonight.

notes.title: Comedy Night - The Big Christmas Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/1aba543866736f64407f3ec94a565bd10e78bf40.jpg
SEASON GREETINGS.
We have just rolled out the biggest update we have ever done to Comedy Night. This Update introduces a bunch of exciting features and addresses many issues that players have raised. 
Here is a breakdown of some of the major features. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/5082f6893df7a1e9cb5202a884f0db8fab7e136b.jpg

NEW FEATURE - PLAYER BANNERS

 Shows your Avatar, Flag, Alias, Social Networks, and Date Joined
 Custom Background with custom colors
 Custom Border with custom glow colors
 View performers Social Networks on their Banners (supports YouTube, Twitter, SoundCloud etc.)
 Easy access to voting players off via your Banner (A big X button appears when voting enabled).
Shows remaining time progress bar below your Badge


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/889b85760dc45c4aae1b7d1f05bc614dd768f32c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/a32a218416f551a5283c2c63d9f45d2097cc18f5.jpg


ROOM SETUP SCREEN

 Complete re-design
 Added support to switch between single and dual-mic whilst in a room
 Added support to turn voting on for both single and dual-mics
 Added support to switch room type from within a room


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/094de0e8d070e883975f437ffeaa1136cce667d5.jpg

LOBBY SCREEN

 Complete re-design
 You can now see all rooms (previously was restricted to just a few)
 You can now see all room types on one screen (previously you had to go into each room type to see if a room was available)
 You can now set up a room without starting it first
 Shows you your last created/edited room in the list for quick access to create it again
 Now shows who the Room Admin or a room is from the lobby.
Added 2 new Lobby Types ( Other makes a return and a new type called Just Chatting


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/63c0c04811b7e5685024c187e51a5f6b025d4146.jpg

TEXT CHAT & IMPROVED GAME UI

 Text Chat (nice way to chat even when a performer is on stage and muted the crowd's voice chat)
 Improved UI in-game


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/93ae91e209509019d10cc138ebde520021e78b11.jpg

OTHER CHANGES AND FEATURES

 Christmas theme with a new song
 2 new free heads (male & female mouth masks)
 3 new premium heads (bag head, plague mask, and gas mask)
 Made it a lot more difficult to enter racist room name and descriptions
 Made it easier to see what is positive emotes vs negative emotes (now color-coded)
 Completely updated networking backend (should be faster)
 Completely updated Microphone support (should work now for all microphones)
 F11 now switches between window and fullscreen
 Improved translation support
 Becoming an admin of a room you are in no longer overwrites your Quick Access Room Name and Description (unless of course, you rename that room, then that by default become your last created room)
 Bloom visual effect should now work on all devices


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30177233/74c0feb0ea49aff2e8d2fb6b1f46cd9a6b1b2ec3.jpg

A Big Thank You

Thank you to everyone for all the great feedback and suggestions, we are already hard at work on the next big update and can't wait to share the details soon.

Have a great festive season
- The Comedy Night Team ( SniperED007 and Wargod)

notes.title: Crowd Chat options
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30177233/4cfbdb4c290273402e715cf3dc939f156d0439cc.jpg

We've had a lot of feedback about the toxic community, players interrupting performers and mic spamming etc. To address this we've given the Room Admin a few more options, by default a new room will now have Crowd Chat disabled whilst a performer is up on stage. The performer still has the option to enable/disable the Crowd Chat whilst performing. 
We've also included the option to auto enable Crowd Chat for a few seconds after a performer has finished (so if you come off stage and the next performer or Announcer goes up the crowd still has a few seconds to comment on your performance - configurable up to 30 seconds). 
You can still set a room to always enable crowd chat if you prefer.

Increased spacing in the admin menu to prevent accidental clicks on "Assign as Room Admin"
Added Cats Ears (Under Hair - *premium content)


Thanks for the feedback!

notes.title: ver 1.1 - What we have done since launch
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30177233/b1e012e01af6f5d2aa5b90b7fe256a714dc03a71.jpg

Since launching just over 6 weeks ago we have been working flat out and have rolled out over 16 updates to the game, many of these updates were based on all your feedback.

Some of the major changes since launch are:

Room Admin controls

Added ability to rename a room
Kick a player off the stage
Kick a player out the room
Ban a player from the room
Enable/Disable voting in Dual Mic Rooms
Make a room private
Added option for Room Admin to Introduce Next performers to the stage


The game quickly spread around the world and expanded from just Comedy to all sorts of things like script readings, music, poetry, self-help sessions as well as live prank calls! To cater for this we implemented the following:

Globalization

Added MacOS X support
Added Linux support
Added 2 additional servers, American and Australian
We now support 9 languages with Korean and Japanese coming soon
You can now filter rooms by languages
We introduced the Music lobby which is very popular with Twitch Streamers
Reduced memory usage for low-end machines
Options Menu - added more settings for low-end machines


http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30177233/ee42d6eefcbc2d2336a37af7f6e7cbf0eb8b5cf3.png

Audio Options

Implemented Normalized performer and crowd audio
Added In-game volume controls for all audio (game SFX, music, crowd, & performers)
Added ability to Mute individual players


We have notified Unity to try to get the Kraken Mic issue fixed, they were able to reproduce it and have logged it as an issue to fix on their side. You can help us by upvoting the issue here on Unity's website:
https://issuetracker.unity3d.com/issues/unity-microphone-does-not-work-with-razer-kraken-7-dot-1-chroma-headsets-while-razer-synapse-is-installed

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30177233/dfa2d492444e9d70755c88960fc39f11dd2924a3.png

Player Content

New Player Setup browser to make it faster to pick the items you want
Free Content - New heads, hairs/hats, bodies and clothing variations, with more female content
Enhanced stage performer animations


We've also just released support for premium content which helps us cover the costs of ongoing support for the game and server costs and keeps the game price low.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30177233/3f7db91ad04d18e2e09cd6e9df500355d2aad977.png

Thanks for all your support, suggestions, and encouragement. We have a long list of new exciting features we will be adding over the next few weeks that we can't wait to share.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30177233/b0b0321c1c394a6d62e582e152f3027eaf9c5bba.jpg

From the team (Neil & Ed) at  
Lighthouse Games Studio 

PS! 
If you enjoying the game and all the update please remember to leave a review, they help spread the game so others can find it and join in!

Defaults to VSync on
Tweaked sound effects
If there are less than 7 rooms it now also shows the rooms that are full
Default camera moved back a bit
When the Room Admin Kicks a player they are notified of it as well as everyone else


* Note - you can force the download by restarting steam

Other changes planned and coming soon:
Ability to adjust volume of Performers, Audience Voice, as well as Game SFX (cheering, etc)
Give Room Admin ability to Hide the room from others
Find your friends and join their room
Bug fixes

notes.title: ver 1.0.7 update released
notes.content:
Thanks for the feedback everyone and the teething first day issues... we have addressed some of the most common requests and bugs with this release:

- Added new Room types:Dual Mic (All ages)
Dual Mic (Adult)
Single Mic (Beginners - Adult)
Single Mic (Professional - Adult)

- Fixed an issue where if you on stage in a full room and you tried to leave the stage it wouldn't let you

- Fixed the issue where Joining a room that was already full would show a message box and then the loading screen and you couldn't do anything (you had to exit the game)

- Fixed an issue where if you tried to join a room and a message box popped up you couldn't use the Joystick to press OK.

Once you have updated it will show ver 1.0.7 on the Main Menu screen.
If it doesn't you can force the update by restarting steam.

Please note that once you update you can only play with other players with this new version too.
